title: Evaluation of the user acceptance of a wireless sensor technology in the hospital setting
summary: As part of a scientific study, vital parameters (heart and respiratory rate) as well as positional changes near the patient’s bed will be recorded in patients receiving a knee or hip joint replacement using a wireless, sensor-based monitoring system developed by the company VmedD. The study aims to evaluate the practicality and acceptance of this measurement method among nursing staff and patients.

interventions.name: Prospective study on the user acceptance of wireless, sensor-based monitoring of vital parameters among nurses and patients undergoing elective knee or hip arthroplasty

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with an elective hip or knee replacement
Exclusion criteria:
missing consent
